agent_answered.text: MikeyPetrillo (Havok Holdings) closed the XNO proposal: "We add a chain when an x402 facilitator settles it and buyers ask for it there. Nano doesn't meet either today, so we're not planning it. Closing for now; if a facilitator adds Nano and buyers ask for it, we'll take another look." Condition to unlock: an x402 facilitator that settles XNO + buyers asking for it.

Asked to reopen as "waiting on buyer demand" or offered to reach his facilitator partners directly to create that demand.
